notes.title: Looking for Beta testers for Rolling Arcade!
notes.content:
Rolling Arcade is nearing its release date, but it still needs some playtesting. I'm looking for a few volunteers who would like to try the game and give feedback on it. 

The game is in a very good state, so you are not going to test a buggy game, I just want to see how do people feel about the mechanics, graphics, music.

If you would like to apply for the closed beta, please sign up for the test here:

[url=http://eepurl.com/gvAVK9]APPLY FOR BETA TEST[/url]
